subject: Ethan Brooks — Candidate debrief and score consensus
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Ethan Brooks — post-interview score capture (quick turn)

Hi team,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview Ethan on Monday. I pulled together the raw notes from the interviews and attached the two interviewer exports (see attachments). We need a final score + one-line justification from each of you by EOD tomorrow so we can close the loop with the recruiter and decide on hire/loop.

Specifically: please reply with a numeric score (1–5) for the three dimensions below and a 1–2 sentence justification:
- Technical (algorithms, systems thinking)
- Product sense (clarity, tradeoff reasoning)
- Team fit (communication, collaboration)

Example: Technical 4 — solid design chops, misses on distributed cache edge-cases.

Attachments: interviewer-notes-ethan-20270712.txt

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ethan Brooks — post-interview score capture (quick turn)

Vanessa,

Technical: 4 — Good system design instincts; asked relevant scaling questions, missed a couple performance micro-optimizations but recoverable.
Product: 3 — Understands tradeoffs but tended to default to conservative choices without articulating user impact.
Team fit: 5 — Clear communicator, humble, asked thoughtful follow-ups.

Attached my filled scorecard: scorecard-marissa-20270713.pdf

Short comment for the record: leaning positive; would recommend for an on-site in a normal cadence — for this role I think he'd be a solid addition if we can pair him with a more senior infra mentor.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff SWE, Serving Runtime
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ethan Brooks — post-interview score capture (quick turn)

Vanessa / Marissa,

Technical: 3 — Competent on whiteboard problems but missed a clearer plan for cache invalidation and KV scaling; would need a short ramp.
Product: 4 — Good at framing the user need when pushed; pragmatic tradeoffs.
Team fit: 4 — Engaging but a touch quiet on cross-team tradeoffs.

Attached: scorecard-connor-20270713.pdf

Note: I'm slightly lower on technical than Marissa — if we were at a tie I might ask for a brief follow-up assignment (1 hr) to validate the cache design. Otherwise fine to move forward.

–Connor
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
connor.obrien@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ethan Brooks — post-interview score capture (quick turn)

Thanks both — appreciate the quick turns. I consolidated the scores and wrote a recommended disposition below. I attached the merged scorecard and a short paragraph we can share with Sarah at BrightPath.

Consolidated (avg):
- Technical: (4 + 3) / 2 = 3.5 → round to 4 (on rubric scale)
- Product: (3 + 4) / 2 = 3.5 → round to 4
- Team fit: (5 + 4) / 2 = 4.5 → round to 5

Recommended disposition: Proceed to offer with a short onboarding plan: pair with senior infra engineer for first 8 weeks to shore up distributed caching practices. Rationale: strong communicator and product judgment; technical gaps are addressable with a targeted ramp.

If either of you strongly objects, please reply by 12:00pm PT today. If silence, I'll share with Sarah and cc Ethan to propose next steps.

Attachments: scorecard-merged-ethan-brooks.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@brightpathtalent.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ethan.brooks@example.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ethan Brooks — post-interview score capture (quick turn)

Vanessa,

Thanks — that disposition works for our timeline. Ethan is available for a verbal offer call tomorrow afternoon (Thursday). I'll hold the window and share the merged scorecard you attached with him so he's aware of the feedback.

Quick ask: can you include the proposed first-90-days onboarding plan in the next note (just 3 bullets) so we can set expectations on both sides?

I'll wait for your note and then book the call.

—Sarah
Sr. Recruiter, BrightPath Talent
sarah@brightpathtalent.com
